translations.idiomatic: Soon he entered the secretariat of Jiang Governor Li Xingrui; Duanfang and Zhou Fu succeeded in turn, and all treated him with great respect.

sentences.zh: 周馥從乃宣議，設簡字學堂於金陵。

translations.literal: Zhou Fu followed Naixuan's proposal and established a Simplified Character Academy at Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Fu adopted Naixuan's proposal and established a Simplified Character Academy at Jinling.

sentences.zh: 初，寧河王照造官話字母，乃宣增其母韻聲號為合聲簡字譜，俾江、浙語音相近處皆可通。

translations.literal: Earlier, Wang Zhao of Ninghe had devised Mandarin phonetic letters; Naixuan expanded their initials, finals, tones, and phonetic marks into a Combined-Sound Simplified Character Manual, so that places in Jiangsu and Zhejiang with similar pronunciation could all communicate.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Wang Zhao of Ninghe had devised Mandarin phonetic letters; Naixuan expanded them into a Combined-Sound Simplified Character Manual with fuller initials, finals, and tone marks, so that regions in Jiangsu and Zhejiang with similar speech could all use it.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，召入都，以四品京堂候補，充憲政編查館參議、政務處提調。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he was summoned to the capital, made a fourth-rank Beijing official awaiting appointment, and served as councillor of the Constitutional Research Office and coordinator of the Office of Government Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year he was summoned to the capital as a fourth-rank Beijing official awaiting appointment, and served as councillor on the Constitutional Research Commission and coordinator of the Office of Government Affairs.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，詔撰經史講義，輪日進呈，疏請造就保姆，輔養聖德。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong an edict ordered the compilation of lectures on the classics and histories, presented in rotation day by day; he memorialized requesting the training of nurse-governesses to assist in nurturing sagely virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuantong an edict ordered lectures on the classics and histories to be compiled and presented in daily rotation; he memorialized asking that nurse-governesses be trained to help nurture the emperor's virtue.

sentences.zh: 二年，欽選資政院碩學通儒議員。

translations.literal: In the second year he was imperially selected as a learned and eminent member of the Political Consultative Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was chosen by imperial command as a learned and eminent member of the Political Consultative Assembly.

sentences.zh: 法律館奏進新刑律，乃宣摘其妨於父子之倫、長幼之序、男女之別者數條，提議修正之。

translations.literal: When the Law Codification Office submitted the new penal code, Naixuan extracted several articles that harmed the relations of father and son, elder and younger, and male and female, and proposed their revision.
translations.idiomatic: When the Law Codification Office submitted the new penal code, Naixuan singled out articles that undermined the relations between father and son, elder and younger, and men and women, and proposed revisions.

sentences.zh: 授江寧提學使。

translations.literal: He was appointed educational commissioner of Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed educational commissioner of Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 三年，召為京師大學堂總監督，兼學部副大臣。

translations.literal: In the third year he was summoned as superintendent of the Capital University and concurrently Vice Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was summoned to serve as superintendent of the Capital University and concurrently as Vice Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 遜位議定，乞休去，隱居淶水。

translations.literal: When abdication was settled, he begged leave and retired, living in seclusion at Laishui.
translations.idiomatic: When abdication was settled, he asked to retire and withdrew to seclusion at Laishui.

sentences.zh: 時士大夫多流寓青島，德人尉禮賢立尊孔文社，延乃宣主社事，著共和正解。

translations.literal: At the time many scholar-officials sojourned in Qingdao; the German Richard Wilhelm founded a Confucian Literary Society, and Naixuan was invited to head its affairs and wrote Correct Interpretation of the Republic.
translations.idiomatic: Many scholar-officials were then living in exile in Qingdao; the German Richard Wilhelm founded a Confucian Literary Society, and Naixuan was invited to head it and wrote Correct Interpretation of the Republic.

sentences.zh: 丁巳復辟，授法部尚書，乃宣時居曲阜，以衰老辭。

translations.literal: At the 1917 restoration he was appointed Minister of Justice; Naixuan was then living in Qufu and declined on grounds of age and infirmity.
translations.idiomatic: At the 1917 restoration he was appointed Minister of Justice, but Naixuan was then in Qufu and declined on grounds of age and infirmity.

sentences.zh: 卒，年七十有九。

translations.literal: He died, aged seventy-nine.
translations.idiomatic: He died at seventy-nine.

sentences.zh: 乃宣誦服儒先，踐履不苟，而於古今政治，四裔情勢，靡弗洞達，世目為通儒。

translations.literal: Naixuan recited and followed the Confucian forebears, practicing without laxity; in ancient and modern politics and the conditions of the four border regions he was thoroughly penetrating, and the world regarded him as a comprehensive scholar.
translations.idiomatic: Naixuan devoted himself to the Confucian forebears and practiced without laxity; he was thoroughly versed in politics ancient and modern and in conditions across the four quarters of the realm, and the world regarded him as a true scholar.

sentences.zh: 著有遺安錄、古籌算考釋、約章纂要、詩文稿。

translations.literal: His writings include Records of Tranquil Rest, Investigations into Ancient Calculation, Essentials of Treaty Compilation, and literary manuscripts.
translations.idiomatic: His writings include Records of Tranquil Rest, Investigations into Ancient Calculation, Essentials of Treaty Compilation, and collected essays and poems.

sentences.zh: 沈曾植，字子培，浙江嘉興人。

translations.literal: Shen Cengzhi, courtesy name Zipei, was a native of Jiaxing in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Cengzhi, whose courtesy name was Zipei, came from Jiaxing in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年進士，用刑部主事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu he passed as jinshi and was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Guangxu he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 事親孝，母多疾，醫藥必親嘗，終歲未嘗解衣安臥，遂通醫。

translations.literal: He served his parents with filial piety; his mother was often ill, and he always tasted medicines himself, going a full year without undressing to sleep at ease, and thus came to master medicine.
translations.idiomatic: He was deeply filial; his mother was often ill, and he always tasted her medicines himself, going a full year without undressing to sleep comfortably, and in this way came to master medicine.

sentences.zh: 遷員外郎，擢郎中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice-director and promoted to director.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice-director and then promoted to director.

sentences.zh: 居刑曹十八年，專研古今律令書，由大明律、宋律統、唐律上溯漢、魏，於是有漢律輯補、晉書刑法志補之作。

translations.literal: For eighteen years in the Penal Code Office he devoted himself to books on laws and ordinances ancient and modern, tracing from the Ming Code and Song Statutes and Tang Code back to Han and Wei, and thus produced Collected Supplements to Han Law and Supplements to the Jin History Treatise on Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: For eighteen years in the Penal Code Office he studied books of laws and ordinances ancient and modern, tracing from the Ming Code and Song Statutes and Tang Code back to Han and Wei, and produced Collected Supplements to Han Law and Supplements to the Jin History Treatise on Punishments.

sentences.zh: 曾植為學兼綜漢、宋，而尤深於史學掌故，後專治遼、金、元三史，及西北輿地，南洋貿遷沿革。

translations.literal: Cengzhi's learning combined Han and Song learning, yet he was especially deep in historical precedent; later he specialized in the histories of Liao, Jin, and Yuan, and in the geography of the northwest and the commercial history of the southern seas.
translations.idiomatic: Cengzhi's learning combined Han and Song traditions, but he was especially deep in historical precedent; later he specialized in the Liao, Jin, and Yuan histories, northwestern geography, and the commercial history of the southern seas.

sentences.zh: 尋充總理衙門章京。

translations.literal: Soon he served as secretary in the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he served as a secretary in the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 中日和議成，曾植請自借英款創辦東三省鐵路，時俄之韋特西比利亞鐵路尚未建議也，不果行。

translations.literal: When the Sino-Japanese peace treaty was concluded, Cengzhi proposed borrowing British funds on his own initiative to establish railways in the three eastern provinces; at the time Russia's Trans-Siberian railway had not yet been proposed, and the plan was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sino-Japanese peace treaty was concluded, Cengzhi proposed borrowing British funds to build railways in the three eastern provinces on his own initiative; Russia's Trans-Siberian railway had not yet even been proposed, and the plan came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 母憂歸，兩湖總督張之洞聘主兩湖書院講席。

translations.literal: When his mother's mourning period required his return, Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of the two Hu engaged him to head the lecture chair at the Two Hu Academy.
translations.idiomatic: After he returned home to mourn his mother, Zhang Zhidong, governor-general of the two Hu, engaged him to head the lecture chair at the Two Hu Academy.

sentences.zh: 拳亂啟釁，曾植與盛宣懷等密商保護長江之策，力疾走江、鄂，決大計於劉坤一、張之洞，而以李鴻章主其成，所謂「畫保東南約」也。

translations.literal: When the Boxer troubles began, Cengzhi with Sheng Xuanhuai and others secretly discussed plans to protect the Yangzi; forcing himself on despite illness he went to Jiangsu and Hubei, settled the great decision with Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong, and had Li Hongzhang bring it to completion—the so-called "Southeast Mutual Protection Pact."
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxer troubles began, Cengzhi joined Sheng Xuanhuai and others in secretly planning to protect the Yangzi; despite illness he hurried to Jiangsu and Hubei, settled the great decision with Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong, and had Li Hongzhang bring it to completion—the so-called "Southeast Mutual Protection Pact."

sentences.zh: 旋還京，調外交部。

translations.literal: Soon he returned to the capital and was transferred to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he returned to the capital and was transferred to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

sentences.zh: 出授江西廣信知府，曾植為政，知民情偽，而持之以忠恕，故事治而民親。

translations.literal: Sent out as prefect of Guangxin in Jiangxi, Cengzhi in government knew the people's true and false ways yet upheld loyalty and forbearance; affairs were well ordered and the people were close to him.
translations.idiomatic: Sent out as prefect of Guangxin in Jiangxi, Cengzhi governed with an eye to the people's true needs and pretenses alike, yet upheld loyalty and forbearance; affairs were well ordered and the people drew close to him.

sentences.zh: 歷署督糧道、鹽法道，擢安徽提學使，赴日本考察學務。

translations.literal: He served in succession as grain intendant and salt commissioner, was promoted to educational commissioner of Anhui, and went to Japan to investigate educational affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He served in succession as grain intendant and salt commissioner, was promoted to educational commissioner of Anhui, and went to Japan to study educational affairs.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，署布政使，尋護巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he acted as provincial treasurer and soon guarded the governorship.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he acted as provincial treasurer and soon served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 值江、鄂、皖三省軍會操太湖，而適遭國卹，群情忷忷，民一日數驚，城外砲馬兵又譁變。

translations.literal: It happened that armies of Jiangsu, Hubei, and Anhui held joint maneuvers at Taihu, and just then the nation suffered imperial mourning; popular feeling was agitated, the people were alarmed several times a day, and outside the city artillery and cavalry troops also mutinied.
translations.idiomatic: Armies from Jiangsu, Hubei, and Anhui were holding joint maneuvers at Taihu just as the court went into mourning; popular feeling was agitated, the people were alarmed several times a day, and outside the city artillery and cavalry troops mutinied as well.

sentences.zh: 曾植聞之，登城守禦，檄協統餘大鴻馳入江防，楚材兵艦擊毀東門外砲兵壁壘，黃鳳岐奪回菱湖嘴火藥局，一日而亂定。

translations.literal: When Cengzhi heard of it, he mounted the wall to defend; he ordered Assistant Commander Yu Dahong to hurry into river defense, the Chucai gunboat to destroy the artillery breastworks outside the east gate, and Huang Fengqi to recover the Linghuzui powder magazine—in one day the disorder was settled.
translations.idiomatic: When Cengzhi heard of it, he mounted the wall to organize the defense; he ordered Assistant Commander Yu Dahong to rush to the river defenses, the gunboat Chucai to destroy the artillery works outside the east gate, and Huang Fengqi to recover the Linghuzui powder magazine—and in a single day the disorder was quelled.

sentences.zh: 曾植在皖五年，重治人而尚禮治，政無鉅細，皆以身先。

translations.literal: Cengzhi was in Anhui five years, stressing governance of people and honoring ritual government; in affairs great and small he always took the lead himself.
translations.idiomatic: Cengzhi spent five years in Anhui, stressing the governance of people and honoring government by ritual; in affairs great and small he always led by example.

sentences.zh: 其任學使，廣教育，設存古學堂。

translations.literal: As educational commissioner he broadened education and established the Preserve Antiquity Academy.
translations.idiomatic: As educational commissioner he broadened education and founded the Preserve Antiquity Academy.

sentences.zh: 又興實業，創造紙諸廠。

translations.literal: He also promoted practical industry and founded paper mills and other factories.
translations.idiomatic: He also promoted practical industry and founded paper mills and other factories.

sentences.zh: 會外人要我訂約開銅官山礦，曾植嚴拒之。

translations.literal: When foreigners demanded a treaty to open the Tongguanshan mines, Cengzhi sternly refused.
translations.idiomatic: When foreigners demanded a treaty to open the Tongguanshan mines, Cengzhi refused sternly.

sentences.zh: 未幾，貝子載振出皖境，當道命籓庫支巨款供張，曾植不允，遂與當道忤。

translations.literal: Before long Prince Zai Zhen left Anhui; the authorities ordered the provincial treasury to disburse huge sums for his entertainment, and Cengzhi would not consent, thus falling out with the authorities.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Prince Zai Zhen left Anhui; the authorities ordered the provincial treasury to disburse huge sums for his entertainment, and Cengzhi refused, falling out with them.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，移病歸。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong he returned home citing illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xuantong he returned home on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 遜位詔下，痛哭不能止。

translations.literal: When the abdication edict was issued, he wept without cease.
translations.idiomatic: When the abdication edict was issued, he wept without stopping.

sentences.zh: 丁巳復辟，授學部尚書。

translations.literal: At the 1917 restoration he was appointed Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: At the 1917 restoration he was appointed Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 事變歸，臥病海上，壬戌冬，卒，年七十三。

translations.literal: When events turned he returned home and lay ill on the coast; in the winter of the renxu year he died, aged seventy-three.
translations.idiomatic: When events turned he went home and lay ill on the coast; in the winter of the renxu year he died at seventy-three.

sentences.zh: 著有海日樓文詩集。

translations.literal: His writings include Collected Essays and Poems of the Hairilou.
translations.idiomatic: His writings include the Collected Essays and Poems of the Hairilou.

sentences.zh: 論曰：辛壬之際，世變推移，莫之為而為，其中蓋有天焉。

translations.literal: Commentary says: In the xin-ren period the world shifted and changed without anyone making it so—within it there was surely Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: In the xin-ren years the world shifted and changed though no one willed it—within it Heaven surely had a hand.

sentences.zh: 潤庠、世續諸人非濟變才，而鞠躬盡瘁，始終如一，亦為人所難者也。

translations.literal: Runxiang, Shi Xu, and the others were not men of talent for meeting change, yet they bent body and exhausted heart from beginning to end alike—a thing difficult for others as well.
translations.idiomatic: Runxiang, Shi Xu, and the others were not men gifted for meeting change, yet they bent body and exhausted heart to the end alike—something difficult for anyone.

sentences.zh: 乃宣、曾植皆碩學有遠識，惓惓不忘，卒憂傷憔悴以死。

translations.literal: Naixuan and Cengzhi were both great scholars of far sight, never forgetting their devotion, and in the end died worn by grief and emaciation.
translations.idiomatic: Naixuan and Cengzhi were both great scholars of far sight who never slackened in devotion, and in the end died worn down by grief.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，豈非天哉！

translations.literal: Alas, was it not Heaven!
translations.idiomatic: Alas—was this not Heaven's doing?
